identity: The Charter of Stone's gather quests by depth tier, given at every own mining camp whose lift reaches the tier (Round 58); no map zone.

quests.title: A Promise in Iron
quests.text: The Charter of Stone has promised the army smiths another load, and my last tally is twenty short. Bring me twenty Iron Lumps; the camp lift's second level is a good place to start looking. A charter is easier to honour when there is something in the cart.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone has promised the army smiths another load, and my last tally is twenty short. Bring me twenty Iron Lumps; the camp lift's second level is a good place to start looking. A charter is easier to honour when there is something in the cart.

The Oathdelvers gave their word to the smiths of The Throng, and I mean to keep it before they come asking again. Bring me twenty Iron Lumps; try the rock beyond the camp lift's second level. I can carry a promise, but I would rather carry the iron.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 2: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t2 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: Four Green Reasons
quests.text: The Charter of Stone's gem workers have sent a very neat request for four pieces of Rough Jade. Bring them to me; the lift's second level puts you at the right depth to look. I have kept their paper clean, which is more than I can say for anything else here.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone's gem workers have sent a very neat request for four pieces of Rough Jade. Bring them to me; the lift's second level puts you at the right depth to look. I have kept their paper clean, which is more than I can say for anything else here.

The Oathdelvers owe their gem workers four pieces of Rough Jade, and I have heard enough about it to remember the number in my sleep. Bring them to me; you can search beyond the lift room on the second level. Small bundle, same oath.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 2: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t2 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: Keep the Forges Fed
quests.text: The army's orders keep the forges busy, and The Charter of Stone has agreed to keep them fed. Bring me twenty pieces of Anthracite; the lift's third level reaches the right rock. The smiths can work wonders, but they cannot burn my apologies.

variants.text: The army's orders keep the forges busy, and The Charter of Stone has agreed to keep them fed. Bring me twenty pieces of Anthracite; the lift's third level reaches the right rock. The smiths can work wonders, but they cannot burn my apologies.

The forges serving The Throng are waiting on us, and The Oathdelvers do not leave a promised load sitting in the deep. Bring me twenty pieces of Anthracite; the lift's third level is a place to look. I would like to hear a hammer for once instead of a complaint.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 3: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t3 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: A Small Order
quests.text: The Charter of Stone has an order for four pieces of Rough Garnet, marked 'small' by someone who will not be carrying it through rock. Bring them to me; the lift's third level reaches their depth. I will handle the tally if you handle the bundle.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone has an order for four pieces of Rough Garnet, marked 'small' by someone who will not be carrying it through rock. Bring them to me; the lift's third level reaches their depth. I will handle the tally if you handle the bundle.

Four pieces of Rough Garnet are still missing from a load The Oathdelvers promised. Bring them to me; try beyond the lift room on the third level. The deep has not agreed to our delivery date, but the gem workers certainly have.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 3: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t3 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: Silver on the Tally
quests.text: The Charter of Stone's workshops need fifteen pieces of Silver, and I have a blank space on the tally that will not fill itself. Bring them to me; the lift's fourth level will take you to the right depth. I would help, but apparently someone must stay here and be asked where everything is.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone's workshops need fifteen pieces of Silver, and I have a blank space on the tally that will not fill itself. Bring them to me; the lift's fourth level will take you to the right depth. I would help, but apparently someone must stay here and be asked where everything is.

The Oathdelvers promised fifteen pieces of Silver to the workshops supplying The Throng. Bring them to me; you can look beyond the lift's fourth level. We have enough empty sacks to start a second camp, and I would rather fill this one.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 4: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t4 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: Something Blue in the Dust
quests.text: The Charter of Stone's gem workers want four pieces of Rough Sapphire, and their order has survived three spills on my desk. Bring them to me; the lift's fourth level reaches the depth to search. Let us finish this before the paper dissolves.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone's gem workers want four pieces of Rough Sapphire, and their order has survived three spills on my desk. Bring them to me; the lift's fourth level reaches the depth to search. Let us finish this before the paper dissolves.

The Oathdelvers have pledged four pieces of Rough Sapphire, and the waiting craftsmen can quote the promise word for word. Bring them to me; start your search beyond the lift room on the fourth level. I remember it too, but that has not satisfied them.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 4: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t4 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: The Next Load
quests.text: The Charter of Stone still has workshops to supply while the army holds the camp. Bring me fifteen pieces of Emberglass; the lift's fifth level reaches the depth we need. I have a cart ready, which is a rare enough event to make use of.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone still has workshops to supply while the army holds the camp. Bring me fifteen pieces of Emberglass; the lift's fifth level reaches the depth we need. I have a cart ready, which is a rare enough event to make use of.

The Oathdelvers have a load to finish for the workshops behind our war effort. Bring me fifteen pieces of Emberglass; take the lift to the fifth level if you need a place to look. The guards are holding up their end of the bargain, and I intend to hold up ours.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 5: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t5 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: Mind the Little Bundle
quests.text: The Charter of Stone needs four pieces of Rough Ruby for its gem workers. Bring them to me; you can search at the lift's fifth level. I have set aside a separate sack, because 'somewhere under the other load' is a miserable entry in a ledger.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone needs four pieces of Rough Ruby for its gem workers. Bring them to me; you can search at the lift's fifth level. I have set aside a separate sack, because 'somewhere under the other load' is a miserable entry in a ledger.

The Oathdelvers have promised four pieces of Rough Ruby, and this bundle is going into my own hands. Bring them to me; the lift's fifth level reaches the rock to search. Last time I asked where a small delivery had gone, everyone pointed at everyone else.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 5: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t5 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: A Load Worth Waiting For
quests.text: The Charter of Stone has an order for ten pieces of Abyssal Crystal, and I have refused to promise when the rock will part with them. Bring them to me; the lift's sixth level reaches their depth. The workshops can wait for a load that comes back safely.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone has an order for ten pieces of Abyssal Crystal, and I have refused to promise when the rock will part with them. Bring them to me; the lift's sixth level reaches their depth. The workshops can wait for a load that comes back safely.

The Oathdelvers have pledged ten pieces of Abyssal Crystal, but the oath does not require anyone to hurry blindly into the deep. Bring them to me; the lift's sixth level reaches the place to search. I would like both you and the order back.

quests.notes: Round 58 gather quest, tier 6: offered at every own camp whose lift reaches the tier (foreman_t6 ... foreman_t6), taken and turned in only there.

quests.title: Four, Counted Twice
quests.text: The Charter of Stone's gem workers need four pieces of Rough Diamond, and I mean to count the bundle twice before it leaves. Bring them to me; you can search beyond the lift's sixth level. My eyes may be tired, but that is no excuse for a bad tally.

variants.text: The Charter of Stone's gem workers need four pieces of Rough Diamond, and I mean to count the bundle twice before it leaves. Bring them to me; you can search beyond the lift's sixth level. My eyes may be tired, but that is no excuse for a bad tally.

The Oathdelvers promised four pieces of Rough Diamond, and I will stand witness when the bundle changes hands. Bring them to me; the lift's sixth level takes you to the depth to look. Down there, mind your footing before you mind the order.
